prompt: What information are you able to provide regarding the ESP32-C-Mini and what is your cut off date
response: The ESP32-C-Mini is a compact version of the ESP32 series, designed for space-constrained applications. It features a 32-bit RISC-V processor, supports Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, and has a range of GPIO pins for interfacing with other devices. The cut-off date for the latest information is December 2023.
